newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks a bit weaker in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks a bit weaker in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were slightly weaker in early morning trade on Friday, but brokers said the down-side of the market was likely to be limited.
They added that there was some position-squaring going on ahead of the weekend.

At 0012 GMT, the cash market's benchmark Nikkei 225 average was 72.27 points, or 0.34 percent, lower at 21,071.07. In the futures market, the key December futures contract was unchanged from the Thursday close at 21,170.
"The benchmark (Nikkei) is supported at the 21,000 level, but on the other hand selling pressure is strong at the 21,300 level," one broker said. "Trade is range bound."
